summary: Vote for Peace rates Kounalakis Opposed in the general election. Her documented record shows Israel-centric framing: she joined interfaith leaders at a Capitol rally calling for the October 7 hostage release and in May 2024 publicly criticized California universities for their handling of Palestinian student protests. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club endorsed her in the primary; CAIR Action lists her as Preferred, a tier below full endorsement.
